the co-doping of scandia-stablized zirconia-based solid solution crystals with Y2O3, or with Yb2O 3, affects their phase composition and structure, which in turn influences their electrical and thermal properties.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of co-dopant on the stabilization of the cubic phase and the transport parameters of ZrO 2–Sc 2 O 3-based solid solution crystals.
the effect of co-dopants and scandia concentrations in the ZrO2-based solid solutions on their transport properties and phase compositions.
the synthesis and properties of transparent cubic zirconia crystals doped with Sc2O3 and co-doped with Y2O3, Yb2O2, and Y3Al5O12.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the effect of co-dopants on the cubic phase stabilization of scandia-stubilized zirconia depends on the dopant type and the scandia concentration in the solid solutions.
the yttria co-impurity is more favorable for the stabilization of the cubic phase and the ytterbia co-impurity for increasing the ionic conductivity of the scandia-doped zirconia crystals.
the co-doping with 1 and 2 mol% of yttria or of ytterbia is a promising way to increase the conductivity of scandia-stablized zirconia.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the co-doping of scandia-stablized zirconia-based crystals with ytterbia and yttria can be used for the development of new materials with improved transport properties.
the co-doping of scandia-stablilized zirconia with ytterbia is preferable to that with yttria.
co-doping of (Zr2O3)1-x(Se2O3)x with Yb2O2 is preferable to Y2O3 for obtaining high-temperature conductive crystals.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the co-doping of scandia-stablized zirconia with Yb2O2 is more effective in increasing the high-temperature ionic conductivity of the crystals.
the effect of the impurity on the cubic phase stabilization and the transport parameters of the scandia-zirconia solid solutions depends on the impurity nature and its concentration.
co-doping of scandia-stabiilzed zirconia with ytterbia is an effective way to improve the high-temperature properties of these materials.
